name: AI Comment Guard
description: Detects and handles abusive, offensive, or harmful language in Drupal comments using the Anthropic Claude API. Supports flag, replace, and block moderation modes.

suggests.drupal/content_moderation: Allows integration with Drupal's core content moderation workflows.

project_description: AI Comment Guard screens each new comment through the Anthropic Claude Messages API before it becomes visible and acts on anything the model judges harmful. A single admin settings form configures the API key, one of three action modes (flag/unpublish for review, replace harmful phrases with a marker, or block by replacing the whole body), an AI sensitivity level, plain-language custom rules appended to the model prompt, optional author email notification, and watchdog logging. Moderation runs on comment presave/insert via core comment hooks; there are no extra routes or entities beyond the settings form. Requires the core comment module and an Anthropic API key; comment text is sent to Anthropic for analysis.
